description: This PHP class defines the 'ReportingMethod' entity for the OrangeHRM system, representing a reporting method with a name and associated report-to relationships. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for mapping to a database table.

classes.name: ReportingMethod
classes.description: Entity class representing a reporting method with an ID, name, and Relationship to 'ReportTo' entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the reporting method.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the reporting method.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the reporting method.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the reporting method.
